notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0006] Compute periods via timedelta floor division: Compute subscription period indices with `(at - start) // timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` as `current_period` does, rather than dividing day counts manually.
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Normalize money via to_money and round_money: In ledgerly/invoice.py, convert any incoming price with to_money() and store it rounded with round_money(); compare against ZERO from ledgerly.money rather than a literal Decimal.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 3x, 3 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with the established codes such as "invalid_state" and "negative_amount", passing repr() of the offending value as detail.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 4x, 3 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0004] Exclude bool when validating integer fields: When validating integer arguments in ledgerly, check isinstance(x, bool) first, since bool is a subclass of int and True would otherwise pass a positive-integer check.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 2 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Use money helpers for all monetary math
item.content: Never round or coerce money with builtin round()/float; import to_money and round_money from ledgerly.money and wrap every monetary computation in them.
